summary: Henry Tuthill the Justice of Southold, great-great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison; John's 10th-great-granduncle.
bio:
Henry Tuthill, known as Henry the Justice, was born at Southold, NY, on 1 May 1665, the son of John Tuthill (1635–1717) and Deliverance King. He was a brother of John Tuthill Jr., John's 10th-great-grandfather, which makes Henry a 10th-great-granduncle rather than a cousin. He served as a justice of the peace and held land in Southold and Brookhaven.

He married Bethia Horton, a granddaughter of William Wells. Their children were Henry, born in 1690; Jonathan (1695–1741), who married Susannah L'Hommedieu, a granddaughter of Thomas Brinley, auditor to Charles I; Nathaniel, who drowned in 1727; Barnabas; and Bethia, who married Samuel Landon. Henry was a great-great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison, and his marriage to Bethia Horton gives the Harrisons a second, independent blood link to John's family through William Wells. A family record says he died at Southold on 4 January 1750, aged 84.
